caption: Porta Palatina, Turin
composition: Roman Porta Palatina twin polygonal brick towers and arched gateway · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist faces the Porta Palatina head-on across the paved forecourt, its two polygonal brick towers flanking the arched central gateway. The pocked Roman brickwork rises in layered arches and small windows, with trees and modern buildings at both edges. The 10:40 sun is bright and high under a blue sky, and the empty plaza emphasizes the gate's massive symmetry.
